_comment: The user's own cipher — editable. Calculation and address logic are sealed in code; this lexicon is the translation layer. Edit any field freely; the engine re-reads at runtime.

0.name: Completion
0.say: Fill and seal. Hand the full coil to its next source.

1.name: Knowledge
1.say: Track the trail. Attend to what can be learned.

2.name: Wisdom
2.say: Let seeing become the means; act on what was shown.

3.name: Understanding
3.say: Stand on the common ground beneath the two.

4.name: Cultured Freedom
4.say: Work the freedom. Till it; it is freedom only once made.

5.name: Powered Refinement
5.pie_root: re- + finis — back to the fine
5.say: Refine by force held steady; bring it back to fineness.

6.name: Equality
6.say: Bring the distinct to par. Pair without flattening.

7.name: Consciousness
7.say: Know with another. This seat is given, not gotten.

8.name: Build / Destroy
8.say: Tear down what was piled wrong; raise it true.

9.name: Birth
9.say: Bear it forth. Carry the made thing into being.
